rules: Every operative predecessor body remains complete and byte-identical. Match source scope ID, original member coordinate, whole body hash, exact JSON pointer and original literal-value hash before selecting the complete canonical target and its distinct target scope.

Identical hashes or schema IDs never authorize scope coalescence. No latest-ID substitution, ambient host-path lookup, network fallback, content-addressed-directory rebasing or active original-source header rollback.

The old native adopted descriptor/composition and original producer descriptor are fully traversed operative predecessor dependencies. Only input-pins, raw frozen external source-edition descriptors and exact reversal provenance carry the preexisting restricted provenance semantics authenticated in original README.

Whole resource banks retain exact literal retrieval URIs and complete original records. Active native and current producer selections continue using the reviewed corrected current schemas; historical custody authorizes no old positive path or old-birth enrollment.
